data.outcome_summary: This OECD Education at a Glance 2025 country note for the Slovak Republic summarizes system-level patterns across educational attainment, labour-market outcomes, adult literacy proficiency (from the OECD Survey of Adult Skills/PIAAC), participation in education and training, demographic pressures, tertiary entry pathways, field-of-study composition, international student mobility, and education spending and staffing conditions. The note reports descriptive benchmarks such as the tertiary-attainment gap by parental education, unemployment rates by educational attainment, literacy shares at or below Level 1 and average literacy differences by attainment group, and trends across PIAAC cycles (Cycle 1 to Cycle 2). It also provides education-system indicators including expenditure per student (by level), funding shares from public vs private sources, teacher turnover, compulsory instruction time, and class size. No student-level modeling, PV estimation, or ML algorithm evaluation is performed in this note; therefore, there are no predictive metrics or causal claims to interpret. Policy meaning is drawn from cross-country comparisons and time trends rather than from an explicit statistical model estimated in this document.
